parent_reconciliation.finding: Trailing arm deadline check rejects an otherwise completed arm at or beyond deadline.
parent_reconciliation.reason: The declared arm wall-time cap includes model evaluation and source-identity verification. Per-operation checks cannot enforce time spent between calls. Completion after the cap is not a valid capped comparison. Checkpoints and fit receipts are written before this check; exception handling retains the in-memory metrics in partial-run.json. No source change.

review.latestTerminalSummary:
One concrete defect:

**`learning/.cache/teacher-onset-review-r2/learning/python/dodge_learning/teacher_onset_ablation.py:596`** — redundant `_expired(arm_deadline, clock)` after all arm work. Every sub-operation (`fit_arm`, `subset_metrics`, `greedy_smoke`) already enforces `arm_deadline` internally. This trailing check uses `>=`, so an arm that completes all required work but finishes exactly at (or a few microseconds past) the deadline raises `AblationTimeout`, writes `failure.json`, and discards a successful matched-budget arm. Failure scenario: a valid onset run whose gameplay/smoke finishes at the 300s boundary is reported as failed despite `epochs_completed == config.epochs` and complete metrics, corrupting the matched comparison. Fix: remove the redundant line (or guard it so completed arms are not failed).

No other substantial defects found across the reviewed categories.
